units.source_text: 第二天早上，龙助急匆匆地来到太吉郎的店里，

en.t: The next morning, Ryusuke hurried to Takichiro's shop,

units.source_text: 马上就把掌柜和店员都召在一起，查起货物来……

en.t: and at once called the manager and all the clerks together and began checking the goods...

units.source_text: 诸如香云绸、白绸、刺绣绉绸、京都绉绸、绫子、

en.t: things such as fragrant-cloud silk, white silk, embroidered crepe silk, Kyoto crepe silk, figured twill,

units.source_text: 特等绉绸、捻线绸、结婚礼服、长袖和服、中袖和服、窄袖和服、

en.t: first-grade crepe silk, twisted-thread silk, wedding garments, long-sleeved kimono, medium-sleeved kimono, narrow-sleeved kimono,

units.source_text: 锦子、缎子、高级印染绸子、出访礼服、腰带、黑绢、和服和零星物品……

en.t: brocade, satin, fine printed and dyed silk, formal visiting wear, obi sashes, black silk, kimono, and miscellaneous small items...
